source.text: Amazon and Meta are in talks to bring back Muse, Meta's AI shopping agent that Amazon kicked off its platform in September. The two sides are stuck on ad revenue and who gets to control search results. That matters because Amazon's ad business generates $68.6 billion a year, and Muse already commands 51 percent of all agentic shopping orders. draft.threads_post:
Meta's AI shopping agent Muse commands 51 percent of all agentic shopping orders.

Amazon kicked Muse off its platform in September, but the two companies are now in talks to bring it back. Negotiations are currently stuck over ad revenue and who controls search results inside Amazon's store, where ad revenue reaches $68.6 billion a year.

Should online stores be allowed to block rival AI shopping agents?
